name: Tushen Taimakon IT (Shirin Jarabawar CompTIA A+)
objectives: Idan aka ba ku hotuna ko jerin sassan kwamfuta, gane kowane babban sashen hardware da faɗin aikinsa, kuna samun aƙalla 8 cikin 10 daidai

Ta amfani da kwamfutarku ta Windows ko Mac, gudanar da ipconfig (ko duba saitunan network) da ping don rubuta adireshin IP da default gateway da gwada haɗin, ba tare da taimako ba, kuma kuna faɗin ma'anar adireshin 169.254
Ta amfani da kwamfutarku, nemo sigar tsarin aiki, wurin ajiya da ya rage, shirye-shiryen da ke aiki da yanayin sabuntawa (updates) da kayan aikin da ke cikin kwamfutar, cikin ƙasa da minti 10
Idan aka ba ku matsalar kwamfuta daga mai amfani, bin hanyar gyara matsala ta CompTIA mai matakai shida da rubuta kowane mataki, da dukkan matakai shida a jerin da ya dace

Idan aka ba ku kira ko saƙo daga mai amfani da ke da matsala, rubuta tikitin help desk da gajeriyar amsa mai ladabi ga mai amfanin, da kowane filin tikiti a cike, babu ɗora laifi ko kalmomin fasaha masu wuya a cikin amsar

Ta amfani da shafukan hukuma na jarabawar CompTIA A+, rubuta shirin karatu da jarabawa da ranakun da kuke nufi don Core 1 da Core 2, da kowane sashe (domain) na jarabawa da nauyinsa da lokacin karatu na mako-mako

chapters.name: Babi na 1: Aikin, hardware da network

lessons.title: Darasi 1: Aikin help desk da jarabawar A+ guda biyu
lessons.text:
Darasi 1 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Jera jarabawar A+ guda biyu, lambobinsu da manyan batutuwan da kowace take ƙunshe da su.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Ta amfani da shafukan hukuma na jarabawar CompTIA A+, za ku iya rubuta shirin karatu da jarabawa da ranakun da kuke nufi don Core 1 da Core 2, da kowane sashe (domain) na jarabawa da nauyinsa da lokacin karatu na mako-mako.
Ma'aikacin taimako yana amsa kira, hira da tikiti, yana shirya kwamfutoci da asusu, yana gyara matsalolin da aka saba gani, kuma ya san lokacin da zai miƙa matsala mai wuya ga babban ma'aikaci. Sunayen aikin sun haɗa da help desk technician, IT support specialist, desktop support da field technician.
CompTIA A+ sananniyar takardar shaida ce ta farko don wannan aiki. CompTIA ce ke bayar da ita, ba wannan kwas ba. Dole ku ci jarabawa biyu. Core 1 (220-1201) tana ƙunshe da na'urorin hannu, network, hardware, virtualization da cloud, da gyara matsalolin hardware da network. Core 2 (220-1202) tana ƙunshe da tsarin aiki, tsaro, gyara matsalolin software da hanyoyin aiki. Kuna iya zana su a kowane jeri.
Lokacin da muka duba a Oktoba 2026, kowace jarabawa tana da tambayoyi har 90 cikin minti 90, da tambayoyin zaɓi (multiple-choice), ja-da-ajiye (drag-and-drop) da tambayoyin aiki (performance-based, ƙananan ayyuka na hannu). CompTIA tana ba da shawarar kusan watanni 12 na ƙwarewar aiki da hannu, amma shawara ce kawai. Jarabawa, farashi da sigogi suna canjawa, don haka koyaushe ku duba shafukan hukuma kafin ku yi rajista.
Kowace jarabawa tana jera sassa (domains) da nauyinsu, wato kason jarabawar da wannan batu yake ɗauka. Lokacin karatunku ya bi waɗannan nauyin.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku buɗe shafin hukuma na CompTIA A+.
- Ku buɗe shafukan jarabawar Core 1 da Core 2.
- Ku rubuta lambar kowace jarabawa da sassanta da nauyinsu.
- Ku nemo farashin yanzu da hanyoyin zana jarabawa (cibiyar jarabawa ko ta intanet) a shafin hukuma.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Help desk: ƙungiyar da mutane ke tuntuɓa idan fasaharsu ba ta aiki.
- Takardar shaida (certification): shaidar da kuke samu ta hanyar cin jarabawa, da ke nuna kuna da wasu ƙwarewa.
- Sashe (domain): fannin batu a jarabawa. Nauyinsa shi ne kason tambayoyin da ke kansa.
- Tambayar aiki (performance-based question): aikin jarabawa inda kuke yin wani abu, kamar haɗa saituna ko gyara tsari, maimakon zaɓar amsa ɗaya.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- Takardar shaidar CompTIA A+ (shafin hukuma)
- Bayanan jarabawar CompTIA A+ Core 1 (220-1201)
- Bayanan jarabawar CompTIA A+ Core 2 (220-1202)
- Ofishin Ƙididdigar Ma'aikata na Amurka (BLS): Ƙwararrun Masu Taimakon Kwamfuta
Gwada yanzu: Ku buɗe shafukan hukuma na Core 1 da Core 2. A takarda, ku yi rukuni biyu, ɗaya don kowace jarabawa. Ku rubuta lambar jarabawar, sannan kowane sashe da nauyinsa. Ku zagaye sashe mafi girma a kowace jarabawa: a nan za ku fi ɓata lokacin karatu.
Yanzu za ku iya faɗin jarabawar A+ guda biyu, lambobinsu da manyan sassansu, da nemo bayanan yanzu a shafin hukuma.

check.q: Jarabawa nawa dole ku ci don samun CompTIA A+?
options: Babu; wannan kwas yana bayar da ita
check.why: A+ tana buƙatar Core 1 da Core 2 duka; kwas ɗin yana shirya ku ne kawai.

check.q: A ina ya kamata ku duba farashin A+ na yanzu da sigar jarabawa?
options: Rubutu a dandalin intanet na bara
Shafin intanet na hukuma na CompTIA
check.why: Farashi da sigogin jarabawa suna canjawa; shafin hukuma ne kaɗai majiya amintacciya.

lessons.title: Darasi 2: Cikin kwamfuta: manyan sassan hardware
lessons.text:
Darasi 2 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Gane manyan sassan hardware na kwamfuta da faɗin aikin kowanne.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku hotuna ko jerin sassan kwamfuta, za ku iya gane kowane babban sashen hardware da faɗin aikinsa, kuna samun aƙalla 8 cikin 10 daidai.
Hardware su ne sassan da za ku iya taɓawa. Motherboard ita ce babban allo da komai ke haɗuwa da shi. CPU (processor) yana yin tunani. RAM (memory) yana riƙe abin da kuke aiki a kai yanzu, kuma yana gogewa idan wuta ta ɗauke. Wurin ajiya (storage) yana riƙe fayilolinku ko da wuta ba ta nan: SSD (solid-state drive, mai sauri, babu sassa masu motsi) ko HDD (hard disk drive, mafi jinkiri, faifai masu juyawa).
Na'urar wuta (PSU) tana mayar da wutar bango zuwa wutar da sassan ke amfani da ita. Katin hoto (GPU) yana zana hoton da ke kan allo; kwamfutoci da yawa suna da hoton a cikin CPU. Kofofin haɗi (ports) a waje sun haɗa da USB (USB-A da ƙaramin USB-C da ake iya juyawa), HDMI da DisplayPort don allo, da Ethernet don network ta waya.
Alamar da aka saba gani a help desk: kwamfuta mai jinkiri da ke da shirye-shirye da yawa a buɗe tana iya buƙatar ƙarin RAM; kwamfutar da ke daɗewa kafin ta tashi tana iya samun drive da ya kusa cika ko tsoho.
Tsaro da farko: ba sai kun buɗe kwamfuta a wannan kwas ba. Ma'aikaci koyaushe yana kashe kwamfuta ya cire ta daga wuta kafin ya buɗe ta, yana sa igiyar hannu mai hana static (anti-static wrist strap), kuma ba ya taɓa buɗe na'urar wuta ko batir da ya kumbura.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Hardware: sassan kwamfuta na zahiri.
- CPU: processor; sashen da ke gudanar da shirye-shirye da yin lissafi.
- RAM: memory na ɗan lokaci da ke riƙe shirye-shirye da fayilolin da ke buɗe; yana gogewa idan wuta ta ɗauke.
- SSD / HDD: drive na ajiya da ke riƙe fayiloli ko da wuta ba ta nan. SSD ya fi sauri kuma ba shi da sassa masu motsi.
- Motherboard: babban allon lantarki da ke haɗa dukkan sassan.
- ESD: electrostatic discharge: ɗan ƙaramin shokin static da zai iya lalata sassan kwamfuta.
Gwada yanzu: Ku duba kwamfutarku daga waje kawai. Ku jera kowace kofar haɗi da kuke gani ku faɗi sunanta (USB-A, USB-C, HDMI, Ethernet, ta belun kunne). Sannan, a Windows ku buɗe Settings > System > About, ko a Mac ku buɗe Apple menu > About This Mac, ku rubuta processor ɗinku da yawan RAM (memory) da kwamfutar take da shi.
Yanzu za ku iya faɗin manyan sassan kwamfuta, faɗin aikin kowanne, da nemo processor da memory na kwamfutarku.

check.q: Wane sashe ne yake riƙe fayilolinku idan an kashe kwamfuta?
check.why: Wurin ajiya (SSD ko HDD) yana riƙe fayiloli; RAM yana gogewa idan wuta ta ɗauke.

check.q: Kafin buɗe kwamfutar tebur, me ma'aikaci zai fara yi?
options: Ya kashe ta ya cire ta daga wuta
Ya cire batir yayin da take aiki
Ya fesa ruwa don sanyaya ta
check.why: Ku kashe ku cire daga wuta da farko; wannan yana kare ku da sassan.

lessons.title: Darasi 3: Tushen network: adireshin IP, ipconfig da ping
lessons.text:
Darasi 3 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Duba haɗin network na kwamfuta da ipconfig da ping, ku rubuta sakamakon.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Ta amfani da kwamfutarku ta Windows ko Mac, za ku iya gudanar da ipconfig (ko duba saitunan network) da ping don rubuta adireshin IP da default gateway da gwada haɗin, ba tare da taimako ba, kuma kuna faɗin ma'anar adireshin 169.254.
Kowace na'ura a network tana samun adireshin IP, kamar adireshin titi don bayanai. A gida yawanci yana kama da 192.168.x.x ko 10.x.x.x. Router ɗinku yana raba waɗannan adireshi da kansa ta hanyar wani sabis da ake kira DHCP. Default gateway shi ne adireshin router: ƙofar fita daga network ɗin gidanku zuwa intanet.
Idan kwamfutar Windows ta nuna adireshi da ke farawa da 169.254, ba ta samu adireshi daga DHCP ba. Wannan babbar alama ce: ku duba waya ko Wi-Fi, sannan router.
Kayan aiki biyu da kowane ma'aikaci ke amfani da su: ipconfig yana nuna adireshin IP ɗinku da default gateway (a Windows, ku buɗe Command Prompt ku rubuta ipconfig). ping yana aika ɗan saƙon gwaji zuwa wata na'ura kuma yana nuna ko ta amsa. Ku fara ping na default gateway; idan ya yi aiki, ku yi ping na shafin intanet kamar comptia.org.
Ku yi atisayen waɗannan a kwamfutarku da network ɗinku kaɗai. Wasu kwamfutocin ɗakin karatu ko na wurin aiki suna hana command prompt; idan haka ne, ku yi amfani da saitunan network don nemo adireshin IP ɗinku.
Mataki-mataki:
- Windows: ku danna maɓallin Windows, ku rubuta cmd ku buɗe Command Prompt. Mac: ku buɗe Terminal.
- Windows: ku rubuta ipconfig ku danna Enter. Ku rubuta IPv4 address da default gateway. Mac: ku nemo adireshin IP da router a System Settings > Network.
- Ku rubuta ping sannan adireshin gateway ɗinku, misali ping 192.168.1.1, ku danna Enter.
- A Mac, ku danna Control da C don dakatar da ping.
- Ku karanta sakamakon: amsoshi (replies) suna nufin haɗin yana aiki; "timed out" ko "unreachable" suna nufin ba ya aiki.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Adireshin IP (IP address): lamba da ke gane na'ura a network.
- DHCP: sabis, yawanci a cikin router, da ke ba na'urori adireshin IP da kansa.
- Default gateway: adireshin router; hanyar fita daga network ɗinku zuwa intanet.
- ipconfig: umarnin Windows da ke nuna saitunan network ɗinku.
- ping: umarni da ke gwada ko wata na'ura tana amsawa ta network.
- Router: akwatin da ke haɗa network ɗin gidanku da intanet.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- Bayanan jarabawar CompTIA A+ Core 1 (220-1201)
Gwada yanzu: A kwamfutarku, ku bi matakan. Ku rubuta adireshin IP ɗinku da default gateway, sannan ku yi ping na gateway da ping na comptia.org. Ku rubuta "yana aiki" ko "ba ya aiki" ga kowanne. Ku ajiye wannan takardar don aikinku na ƙarshe.
Yanzu za ku iya nemo adireshin IP ɗinku da default gateway, gwada haɗi da ping, da faɗin ma'anar adireshin 169.254.

check.q: Kwamfutar tafi-da-gidanka ta Windows ta nuna adireshin IP 169.254.20.5. Me wannan yake faɗa muku?
options: Ba ta samu adireshi daga DHCP ba
check.why: Adireshin 169.254 yana nufin na'urar ba ta kai ga DHCP ba, don haka ku duba haɗin da router.

check.q: Wane umarni ne ke nuna adireshin IP da default gateway na kwamfutar Windows?
check.why: ipconfig yana nuna saitunan network ɗinku; ping yana gwada haɗi.

chapters.name: Babi na 2: Tsarin aiki, gyara matsala da shirinku

lessons.title: Darasi 4: Kayan aikin tsarin aiki da kuke amfani da su kullum
lessons.text:
Darasi 4 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Nemo sigar tsarin, wurin ajiya da ya rage, shirye-shiryen da ke aiki da yanayin sabuntawa a kwamfutarku.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Ta amfani da kwamfutarku, za ku iya nemo sigar tsarin aiki, wurin ajiya da ya rage, shirye-shiryen da ke aiki da yanayin sabuntawa (updates) da kayan aikin da ke cikin kwamfutar, cikin ƙasa da minti 10.
Tsarin aiki (operating system, OS) shi ne babban shirin da ke gudanar da kwamfuta: Windows, macOS, Linux, ko a waya Android da iOS. A+ Core 2 tana sa ran ku iya kewaya cikin waɗannan.
A Windows: Settings > System > About yana nuna sigar. Settings > System > Storage yana nuna wurin da ya rage. Task Manager (ku danna Ctrl + Shift + Esc) yana nuna shirye-shiryen da ke aiki da yadda CPU da memory ke aiki tuƙuru; kuna iya rufe shirin da ya daskare a can. Settings > Windows Update yana nuna ko akwai sabuntawa da ke jira.
A Mac: Apple menu > About This Mac yana nuna sigar. Activity Monitor (ku nemo shi da Spotlight) yana nuna shirye-shiryen da ke aiki. System Settings > General > Software Update yana nuna sabuntawa. Wurin ajiya yana ƙarƙashin System Settings > General > Storage.
Kyawawan halaye na tsaro suna cikin aikin: ku saka sabuntawa, ku bar antivirus da ke cikin kwamfutar a kunne (Microsoft Defender a Windows), ku yi amfani da asusu na yau da kullum (ba na admin ba) don aikin kullum, kuma ku kulle allo idan za ku tashi (maɓallin Windows + L a Windows).
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku nemo sunan OS da sigarsa.
- Ku nemo yawan wurin ajiya da ya rage.
- Ku buɗe Task Manager ko Activity Monitor ku nemo shirin da ya fi amfani da memory.
- Ku duba sabuntawa.
- Ku kulle allonku, sannan ku buɗe shi.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Tsarin aiki (OS): babban software da ke gudanar da kwamfuta ko waya, kamar Windows ko macOS.
- Task Manager: kayan aikin Windows da ke nuna shirye-shiryen da ke aiki kuma yana bar ku rufe wanda ya daskare.
- Activity Monitor: kayan aikin Mac da ke nuna shirye-shiryen da ke aiki.
- Asusun admin: asusu da zai iya saka software da canja saituna. Aikin kullum ya kamata ya yi amfani da asusu na yau da kullum (standard).
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- Bayanan jarabawar CompTIA A+ Core 2 (220-1202)
Gwada yanzu: A kwamfutarku, ku rubuta: sunan OS da sigarsa, wurin ajiya da ya rage, shirin da ya fi amfani da memory yanzu, da ko akwai sabuntawa da ke jira. Ku ƙara wannan a takardar network ɗinku daga Darasi na 3. Yanzu kuna da yawancin sashe na 2 na aikinku na ƙarshe.
Yanzu za ku iya amfani da kayan aikin da ke cikin kwamfuta don duba sigarta, wurin ajiya, shirye-shiryen da ke aiki da sabuntawa.

check.q: Wani shiri ya daskare a Windows. Wane kayan aiki ne zai bar ku rufe shi?
check.why: Task Manager yana nuna shirye-shiryen da ke aiki kuma yana iya rufe wanda ya daskare.

check.q: Wace al'ada ce ta fi aminci don aikin kullum?
options: Amfani da asusu na yau da kullum da barin sabuntawa a kunne
check.why: Asusu na yau da kullum da sabuntawa na yanzu suna rage ɓarna idan wani abu ya lalace.

lessons.title: Darasi 5: Hanyar gyara matsala mai matakai shida
lessons.text:
Darasi 5 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Bin matakai shida na gyara matsala na CompTIA kan wata matsala, a jere.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku matsalar kwamfuta daga mai amfani, za ku iya bin hanyar gyara matsala ta CompTIA mai matakai shida da rubuta kowane mataki, da dukkan matakai shida a jerin da ya dace.
Ƙwararrun ma'aikata ba sa yin hasashe kawai. Suna bin hanya. Manufofin A+ suna amfani da matakai shida: 1. Gane matsalar. 2. Kafa ra'ayin sanadin da ya fi yiwuwa (ku tambayi abubuwa masu sauƙi da farko). 3. Gwada ra'ayin don nemo sanadin. 4. Yi shirin aiki ku aiwatar da gyaran. 5. Tabbatar cewa dukan tsarin yana aiki kuma, idan zai taimaka, ku ɗauki matakai don hana ta sake faruwa. 6. Rubuta abin da kuka gano, abin da kuka yi da sakamakon.
Mataki na 1 yana nufin yi wa mai amfani tambayoyi: Me ya faru? Yaushe ya fara? Shin wani abu ya canja? Akwai saƙon kuskure (error)? Ku yi ajiyar bayanai masu muhimmanci (backup) kafin ku canja komai.
Mataki na 2 yana nufin fara da sanadai masu sauƙi: Shin an saka shi a wuta? Wi-Fi yana kunne? An sake kunna shi? Idan ra'ayinku na farko bai yi daidai ba, ku yi sabo ku sake gwadawa, ko ku miƙa (escalate) ga babban ma'aikaci.
Misali: firinta ba ya bugawa. Ra'ayi: ba ya kan layi (offline). Gwaji: allon firintan yana nuna takarda ta maƙale. Gyara: a cire takardar da aka maƙale lafiya. Tabbatarwa: a buga shafin gwaji. Rubutawa: "Takarda ta maƙale a tray 2, an cire, an buga shafin gwaji."
Mataki-mataki:
- Gane matsalar: ku yi tambayoyi, ku yi backup na bayanai.
- Kafa ra'ayin sanadin da ya fi yiwuwa: ku fara da abubuwa masu sauƙi.
- Gwada ra'ayin. Bai yi daidai ba? Ku yi sabon ra'ayi ko ku miƙa.
- Ku yi shiri ku aiwatar da gyaran.
- Ku tabbatar yana aiki kuma ku hana sake faruwa idan kuna iya.
- Ku rubuta abin da kuka gano, ayyuka da sakamako.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Gyara matsala (troubleshooting): nemo da gyara sanadin matsala mataki-mataki.
- Ra'ayin sanadin da ya fi yiwuwa: mafi kyawun tsammaninku game da abin da ke jawo matsalar.
- Miƙawa (escalate): ba da matsala ga wanda ke da ƙarin ƙwarewa ko iko.
- Rubutawa (document): rubuta abin da kuka gano da abin da kuka yi, yawanci a cikin tikiti.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- Bayanan jarabawar CompTIA A+ Core 1 (220-1201)
Gwada yanzu: Ku zaɓi matsala ta gaske da kuka taɓa samu (kwamfuta mai jinkiri, babu Wi-Fi, wayar da ba ta caji) ko ku yi amfani da: "Mai amfani ba zai iya haɗuwa da Wi-Fi ba bayan ya koma wani tebur." Ku rubuta dukkan matakai shida a takarda, da abin da za ku tambaya, ku duba, ku rubuta a kowane mataki.
Yanzu za ku iya bin matakai shida na gyara matsala kan wata matsala da rubuta kowanne.

check.q: Mene ne mataki na FARKO na gyara matsala?
options: Tabbatar cewa dukan tsarin yana aiki
check.why: Dole ku fahimci matsalar kafin ku yi tsammanin sanadi.

check.q: Kun gyara matsalar. Me yake zuwa kafin ku rubuta ta?
options: Tabbatar cewa dukan tsarin yana aiki
Rufe tikitin ba tare da faɗa wa mai amfani ba
Yin backup na bayanai a karon farko
check.why: Mataki na 5 shi ne tabbatar cewa komai yana aiki; mataki na 6 shi ne rubutawa.

lessons.title: Darasi 6: Tikiti, magana da masu amfani, da shirin karatunku na A+
lessons.text:
Darasi 6 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Rubuta cikakken tikitin help desk da shirin karatu da jarabawa na A+ mai ranaku.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku kira ko saƙo daga mai amfani da ke da matsala, za ku iya rubuta tikitin help desk da gajeriyar amsa mai ladabi ga mai amfanin, da kowane filin tikiti a cike, babu ɗora laifi ko kalmomin fasaha masu wuya a cikin amsar. Ta amfani da shafukan hukuma na jarabawar CompTIA A+, za ku iya rubuta shirin karatu da jarabawa da ranakun da kuke nufi don Core 1 da Core 2, da kowane sashe (domain) na jarabawa da nauyinsa da lokacin karatu na mako-mako.
Tikiti shi ne bayanin rubuce na matsala ɗaya. Tikiti mai kyau yana da: sunan mai amfani da yadda za a same shi (a aiki na gaske, daga tsarin kamfanin), na'urar, gajeren taƙaitaccen bayani, cikakkun bayanai da duk wani saƙon kuskure, fifiko (priority, yadda yake da gaggawa), matakan da aka ɗauka, da sakamakon. Ku rubuta shi ta yadda wani ma'aikaci zai iya ɗaukarsa ya fahimta.
Yadda kuke magana yana da muhimmanci kamar gyaran. Ku saurara ba tare da katse magana ba, ku maimaita matsalar ga mai amfanin, ku yi amfani da kalmomi masu sauƙi, kada ku taɓa ɗora wa mai amfani laifi, ku faɗi lokacin da za ku ba shi labari, kuma ku tabbatar da shi cewa an gyara kafin ku rufe tikitin. Ku kiyaye bayanansa a sirri.
Yanzu ku shirya jarabawarku. Ku yi amfani da nauyin sassan da kuka rubuta a Darasi na 1. Ku zaɓi ranar da kuke nufi don kowace jarabawa. Ku ba manyan sassa ƙarin makonni. Ku yi amfani da atisaye kyauta: takardar manufofin jarabawa (exam objectives) ta CompTIA kyauta, kwamfutarku, da gwaje-gwajen ilimi da ke nan. Mutane da yawa suna karatu awa 5 zuwa 10 a mako; ku zaɓi abin da ya dace da rayuwarku ku rubuta shi.
Kafin ku yi rajista, ku duba shafin hukuma don farashin yanzu, duk wani shirin rangwame da hanyoyin zana jarabawa. Cibiyoyin aiki (workforce centers), shirye-shiryen tsoffin sojoji da shirye-shiryen masu dawowa gida wani lokaci suna taimakawa da kuɗin jarabawa, don haka ku tambayi naku.
Mataki-mataki:
- Tikiti: ku cike mai amfani, na'ura, taƙaitaccen bayani, cikakkun bayanai, fifiko, matakan da aka ɗauka da sakamako.
- Amsa: ku gode masa, ku faɗi abin da kuka gano da kalmomi masu sauƙi, ku faɗi abin da zai biyo baya da lokacinsa.
- Shiri: ku rubuta ranar da kuke nufi don Core 1 da Core 2.
- Ku jera kowane sashe da nauyinsa da makonnin da kuka ba shi.
- Ku rubuta awannin karatunku na mako-mako da inda za ku yi karatu.
- Ku duba shafin hukuma don farashi da hanyoyin zana jarabawa; ku tambayi shirin yankinku game da taimakon kuɗi.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Tikiti (ticket): bayanin rubuce na buƙatar taimako ɗaya, daga farko har ƙarshe.
- Fifiko (priority): yadda tikiti yake da gaggawa, sau da yawa low, medium, high ko critical.
- Shirin karatu: jadawali na rubuce na abin da za ku karanta, yaushe, da ranar jarabawarku.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- Takardar shaidar CompTIA A+ (shafin hukuma)
- Bayanan jarabawar CompTIA A+ Core 1 (220-1201)
- Bayanan jarabawar CompTIA A+ Core 2 (220-1202)
Gwada yanzu: Aikin ƙarshe: ku rubuta tikitin matsalarku ta Darasi na 5 da kowane fili da matakai shida, tare da amsa mai jimloli biyu ga mai amfanin. Ku sa takardar kwamfutarku daga Darasi na 3 da na 4 a shafi ɗaya. Sannan ku rubuta shirin karatu da jarabawarku na A+: ranakun da kuke nufi don Core 1 da Core 2, kowane sashe da nauyinsa, da awannin ku na mako-mako.
Yanzu za ku iya rubuta tikitin taimako mai sarari, amsa wa mai amfani cikin ladabi, da bin shirinku mai ranaku zuwa jarabawar A+ guda biyu.
Yadda ake duba aikinku na ƙarshe:
Abin da muke dubawa Har yanzu bai kai ba Ya cika Ya wuce Takardar kwamfuta Babu sigar OS, wurin ajiya da ya rage ko sabuntawa. Ta jera OS da sigarsa, wurin ajiya da ya rage, shirin da ya fi amfani da memory da yanayin sabuntawa. Ta kuma jera processor da RAM kuma ta faɗi abin da suke nufi ga sauri. Duba network Babu adireshin IP ko gateway, ko ba a gwada ping ba. Ta rubuta adireshin IP da gateway da sakamakon ping na gateway da na shafin intanet. Ta bayyana abin da sakamakon zai nufa idan ping ɗaya bai yi aiki ba, har da adireshin 169.254. Matakan gyara matsala Wasu matakai sun ɓace ko ba a jere suke ba, ko gyaran hasashe ne kawai. Dukkan matakai shida a jere, da abin da aka tambaya, aka gwada da aka yi. Ya haɗa da ra'ayi na biyu ko wurin miƙawa da hanyar hana sake faruwa. Tikiti da amsa Tikitin bai da sarari ko amsar tana ɗora wa mai amfani laifi ko tana amfani da kalmomin fasaha masu wuya. Kowane filin tikiti a cike yake; amsar tana da ladabi, a sarari kuma tana faɗin abin da zai biyo baya. Wani mutum zai iya bin tikitin ba tare da yin wata tambaya ba. Shirin karatu da jarabawa Babu ranaku, ko wasu sassa sun ɓace. Ranakun da ake nufi don Core 1 da Core 2, kowane sashe da nauyinsa, awannin mako-mako. Shirin yana ba sassa masu nauyi ƙarin makonni kuma yana faɗin inda za a duba farashi da samun taimakon kuɗi. Kalmomin hardware An faɗi sunayen sassan hardware ba daidai ba a takarda ko tikiti. An faɗi sunayen sassa da kofofin haɗi daidai. Ya haɗa alama da sashen da ya fi yiwuwa, misali jinkiri da shirye-shirye da yawa a buɗe da RAM kaɗan. Don cin nasara: "Ya cika" ko "Ya wuce" a kowane layi. Idan wani layi "Bai kai ba tukuna", ku gyara wannan sashe ku sake gwadawa.

check.q: Wane taƙaitaccen bayanin tikiti ne ya fi amfani?
options: "Kwamfutar tafi-da-gidanka ba ta haɗuwa da Wi-Fi na ofis tun da aka koma tebur 14; kuskure: babu intanet."
check.why: Yana faɗin na'urar, matsalar, lokacin da ta fara da kuskuren, ba tare da ɗora laifi ba.

check.q: Core 1 tana da sashe mai nauyin 28% da wani mai 11%. Yaya ya kamata ku shirya?
options: Ku ba sashen 28% ƙarin lokacin karatu
check.why: Nauyi mafi girma yana nufin ƙarin tambayoyi, don haka ya cancanci ƙarin lokacin karatu.
